title: Grilled Street Corn Salad (Esquites Style)
instructions: Prep all ingredients for Grilled Street Corn Salad (Esquites Style): One green onion, Two corn grilled, Half a lime squeezed, 1/2 tbsp mayo.
Cook and assemble according to the doc method: One green onion Two corn grilled Half a lime squeezed 1/2 tbsp mayo Salt pepper Paprika smoked Cilantro bunch.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and acidity to taste and serve hot.
